purpose: Declared, counted, shrink-only ledger of audit violations present at ratification. Read by audit_engine::apply_debt_ledger. A violation whose identity is absent here fails the gate; a ledger entry with no observed violation also fails the gate, because paid debt left in the ledger hides that the ledger is stale.

rule.growth: blocked -- a new identity, or a count above the recorded one, fails
rule.shrink: required -- an entry with no observed violation must be deleted
rule.why_not_a_threshold: A threshold is a policy that erodes: it tolerates the next violation by construction. An exact per-identity count does not, because any increase is a distinct, named failure.

identity_policy.measured_reason: the message embeds a line count that changes on any edit; keying on it would force regeneration on every edit and turn a deliberate act into muscle memory
identity_policy.default_reason: the 15 ARCH-004 edges share one span.file_path and differ only by message, so keying on the file would collapse 15 distinct violations into one and hide a partial repair
